main_text.p: שלף Ch. Eduxit, exuit, extraxit, strinxit, detraxit, serè semper de gladio ut Hebr. De calceis וּמְסָנְךָ תְּשְׁלוּף Et calceos tuos detrahes, Jesa. 20. 2. Sic Deuteronom. 25. 9. 10. in Jonath. Aliter, Numeror. 21. 36. in Jon. בָּעֵי לְמִשְׁלְפֵיהּ רִישׁוּרֵי Quaesivit extrahere eum à capite suo, id est amovere; De lapidibus, בָּתֵר דִּשְׁלִיפוּ יַת אַבְנַיָּא Postquam eruerunt lapides, Levit. 14. 43. שְׁלַף וּמְטַעְיִית לְבָהוֹן Educit, vel seducit, & in errorem compellit cor eorum, Hos. 4. 11. Ithpeh. אִשְׁתְּלִיף & Ithpahel אִשְׁתַּלַף Evaginari, educi, extrahi, evelli, avelli, exsilire, 2. Reg. 6. 5. Judic. 5. 22. Ezech. 21. 16. 10. Numer. 25. 8. in Jon.
שַׁלְפוּקִין Ch. Pustulae, Exo. 9. 9. 10. in Targ. Jonath. Vide quoque supra in שלב.
שְׁלַק Ch. Uredine periit, 2. Reg. 19. 26. & Jesa. 37. 27. Respondet Hebr. שַׁרְפָּה & שְׁרָפָה.
שַׁלְשֵׁל Pahel Ch. Catenavit, incatenavit, demisit per catenam, Jos. 2. 18. 15. Ithpah. מִשְׁתַּלְשֵׁל Catenari, incatenari, Jobi 12. 17.
שַׁלְשְׁלָא Ch. Idem. Plur. שַׁלְשְׁלָן, שַׁלְשְׁלָן, Catenae, Vincula; & שַׁלְשְׁלוּן, Psal. 107. 14. שַׁלְשְׁלָן Psal. 118. 27. שַׁלְשְׁוּן Esth. 1. 1. in T. sec. שׁוּלְשְׁלִי, Psal. 129. 4.
שְׁלַת ܫܠܬ Syr. Stillę, Grumi, Lucę 22. 44. Tremellius vertit, Demissiones.
שֵׁם שְׁמָא Ch. & Syr. Nomen: Item καὶ ἐξοχὴν, Deus Plural. Chald. שְׁמַהְתָּא, שְׁמַהָן, Nomina, Syriac. ܫܡܐ ad Phil. 2. 10. emp. ܫܡܐ cōst. ܫܡܐ.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek forms are transcribed from the scan and are approximate in places; the Syriac and some vocalised Hebrew words are doubtful. Catchword "Hinc" taken from the foot of the page.
